ops.oldText: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: Vendor will be a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services to Customer, and Customer may procure equivalent services from any third party.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot commit to a sole-supplier arrangement, so we have made Vendor's appointment non-exclusive. This also removes the conflict with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that we have given no exclusivity commitment.
input.summary: Make Vendor a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services
